ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky (APT43 / Velvet Chollima) LNK-borne PowerShell payload extraction chain
ucs.description: Hunts Kimsuky's signature initial-access tradecraft — a shortcut (LNK) lure delivered by spear-phishing (frequently disguised as a Hancom HWP, PDF, or Word document targeting Korean think-tanks, defectors, academics, and government) which, when clicked from Explorer, spawns powershell.exe with the cluster's characteristic embedded-blob extraction primitives (Get-Content -Stream / FromBase64String / Out-File) reading from the lure file in Downloads or %TEMP%. This combination of parent, child, extraction APIs, lure-path, and hidden/bypass switches is heavily reported against Kimsuky (Microsoft
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*Get-Content*" OR Processes.process="*Out-File*" OR Processes.process="*[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes*" OR Processes.process="*Start-Process*") AND (Processes.process="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process="*$env:TEMP*" OR Processes.process="*$env:APPDATA*" OR Processes.process="*$env:PUBLIC*") AND (Processes.process="*.lnk*" OR Processes.process="*.hwp*" OR Processes.process="*.pdf*" OR Processes.process="*.docx*" OR Processes.process="*.zip*" OR Processes.process="*WindowStyle Hidden*" OR Processes.process="*-nop*" OR Processes.process="*-ep bypass*" OR Processes.process="*-w hidden*") by host, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process, Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "\\$$") | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Kimsuky / APT43 / Velvet Chollima LNK -> PowerShell payload extraction
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","Get-Content","Out-File","[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes","Start-Process")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(\$env:(TEMP|APPDATA|PUBLIC)|\\Users\\[^\\]+\\(Downloads|AppData\\Local\\Temp)|\\Users\\Public\\)"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".lnk",".hwp",".pdf",".docx",".zip")
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-(W(in)?(dow)?Style?\s+H(idden)?|nop|noni|ep\s+bypass|w\s+hidden)"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Kimsuky LNK -> PowerShell payload extraction (Sentinel SecurityEvent / 4688)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\explorer.exe" or ParentProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","Get-Content","Out-File","[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes","Start-Process")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(\$env:(TEMP|APPDATA|PUBLIC)|\\Users\\[^\\]+\\(Downloads|AppData\\Local\\Temp)|\\Users\\Public\\)"
| where CommandLine has_any (".lnk",".hwp",".pdf",".docx",".zip")
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-(W(in)?(dow)?Style?\s+H(idden)?|nop|noni|ep\s+bypass|w\s+hidden)"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Kimsuky LNK-Borne PowerShell Payload Extraction Chain
id: 8f7e3c91-1d4a-4b2f-a3e5-9c4d6e8b1a2f
status: experimental
description: Detects Kimsuky (APT43 / Velvet Chollima / Emerald Sleet) signature initial-access chain where an LNK lure launched from Explorer spawns powershell.exe with embedded-blob extraction primitives reading the lure document from Downloads / Temp / Public.
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094/
tags:
  - attack.initial-access
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g0094
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_cmd_extract:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'Get-Content'
      - 'Out-File'
      - '[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes'
      - 'Start-Process'
  selection_cmd_location:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '$env:TEMP'
      - '$env:APPDATA'
      - '$env:PUBLIC'
  selection_cmd_evasion:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '.lnk'
      - '.hwp'
      - 'WindowStyle Hidden'
      - '-nop'
      - '-ep bypass'
      - '-w hidden'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd_extract and selection_cmd_location and selection_cmd_evasion
falsepositives:
  - Custom administrative scripts that extract and execute content from user-writable paths
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\pwsh.EXE) @CommandLine:(*FromBase64String* OR *Get-Content* OR *Out-File* OR *"[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes"* OR *Start-Process*) AND @CommandLine:(*\\Downloads\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *$env:TEMP* OR *$env:APPDATA* OR *$env:PUBLIC*) AND @CommandLine:(*.lnk* OR *.hwp* OR *.pdf* OR *.docx* OR *.zip* OR *"WindowStyle Hidden"* OR *-nop* OR *"-ep bypass"* OR *"-w hidden"*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(explorer|cmd)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/(FromBase64String|Get-Content|Out-File|\[IO\.File\]::WriteAllBytes|Start-Process)/i
| CommandLine=/(\\Downloads\\|\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\|\\Users\\Public\\|\$env:(TEMP|APPDATA|PUBLIC))/i
| CommandLine=/(\.lnk|\.hwp|\.pdf|\.docx?|\.zip|WindowStyle\s+Hidden|-nop|-ep\s+bypass|-w\s+hidden)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: The combination is distinctive to Kimsuky's documented kit (BabyShark, AppleSeed, FlowerPower droppers): LNK clicked from Explorer -> hidden powershell -> Get-Content on the lure file by NTFS stream offset -> base64 decode -> Out-File the next stage into %TEMP% / %APPDATA% / Public. Generic PowerShell hunts will miss this if they only look at -EncodedCommand; Kimsuky's loaders avoid -enc and inste

ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky AppleSeed / BabyShark cloud-API C2 from non-browser process (pCloud / Dropbox / Yandex)
ucs.description: Hunts Kimsuky's hallmark C2 channel — AppleSeed, BabyShark, and FlowerPower variants beacon over HTTPS to legitimate file-hosting REST APIs (pCloud, Dropbox, Yandex.Disk, Mail.ru Cloud) using hard-coded OAuth tokens, blending into normal cloud-sync traffic. Detection fires when one of these specific API endpoints is contacted from a non-browser, non-vendor-client process, especially script hosts or binaries running out of writable user / Public / ProgramData paths.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dest_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dest_port sum(All_Traffic.bytes_out) as bytes_out from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest IN ("api-content.dropbox.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","api.pcloud.com","binapi.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com","cloud.mail.ru")) AND NOT All_Traffic.app IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","dropbox.exe","onedrive.exe","yandexdisk.exe","disk.exe","Disk-O.exe") by host, All_Traffic.app, All_Traffic.process_path, All_Traffic.dest, All_Traffic.user | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Kimsuky AppleSeed / BabyShark cloud-API C2 from non-browser process
let CloudC2Domains = dynamic([
    "api-content.dropbox.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com",
    "api.pcloud.com","binapi.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com",
    "cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com",
    "cloud.mail.ru"
]);
let ExpectedClients = dynamic([
    "msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe",
    "onedrive.exe","dropbox.exe","yandexdisk.exe","disk.exe","disk-o.exe",
    "msteams.exe","outlook.exe","searchapp.exe","searchhost.exe",
    "officeclicktorun.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe"
]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2Domains)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (ExpectedClients)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
   or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\ProgramData\")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), HitCount = count(), AnyCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), Endpoints = make_set(RemoteUrl, 20)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Kimsuky cloud-API C2 from non-browser process (ASIM network session)
let CloudC2Domains = dynamic([
    "api-content.dropbox.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com",
    "api.pcloud.com","binapi.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com",
    "cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com","cloud.mail.ru"
]);
let ExpectedClients = dynamic([
    "msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe",
    "onedrive.exe","dropbox.exe","yandexdisk.exe","disk.exe","disk-o.exe",
    "msteams.exe","outlook.exe"
]);
let NetHits = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where DstHostname has_any (CloudC2Domains) or Url has_any (CloudC2Domains)
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcUsername, DstHostname, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, Url, NetworkBytes;
let SuspectProcs = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
       or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\ProgramData\")
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
NetHits
| join kind=inner SuspectProcs on DvcHostname
| where ProcTime between (TimeGenerated - 5m .. TimeGenerated + 30s)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, DstHostname, Url, DstIpAddr, NetworkBytes
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(api-content.dropbox.com OR content.dropboxapi.com OR api.dropboxapi.com OR api.pcloud.com OR binapi.pcloud.com OR eapi.pcloud.com OR cloud-api.yandex.net OR webdav.yandex.com OR cloud.mail.ru) -@Image:(*\\chrome.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\brave.exe OR *\\iexplore.exe OR *\\dropbox.exe OR *\\Dropbox.exe OR *\\OneDrive.exe OR *\\onedrive.exe OR *\\yandexdisk.exe OR *\\YandexDisk.exe OR *\\Disk-O.exe OR *\\msteams.exe OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE) AND (@Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CertUtil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\BitsAdmin.exe) OR @Image:(*\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(^|\.)(dropboxapi\.com|api-content\.dropbox\.com|pcloud\.com|cloud-api\.yandex\.net|webdav\.yandex\.com|cloud\.mail\.ru)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|dropbox|onedrive|yandexdisk|disk-o|msteams|outlook)\.exe$/i
| ContextImageFileName=/(\\(powershell|pwsh|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|curl|certutil|bitsadmin)\.exe$|\\(Users\\Public|AppData\\Local\\Temp|AppData\\Roaming|ProgramData)\\)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())
| _count > 0
ucs.rationale: Kimsuky's AppleSeed/BabyShark families are repeatedly documented (KrCERT, Kaspersky, AhnLab, Mandiant APT43 report, Microsoft Emerald Sleet) using pCloud, Dropbox, and Yandex.Disk REST APIs with embedded OAuth tokens — this is the cluster's preferred C2/exfil channel because the destinations are trusted SaaS endpoints and TLS hides the token. Many APTs use Dropbox, but the pCloud + Yandex pairing
